name: Sunday Times cryptic crossword, Penguin book 2 No 75

clue.text: Instrumental in a grisly revolution!
Breakaway catch I miss, perhaps
Ship’s gear and northern bird no part of your knowledge
See the attachments for missing jewellery ?
Not much of a writer, but he has a gentle way with a horse ~
A set not arranged with lack of perception
It’s strange, but Hans will give you a tanning
Kind of light service returned from an extremely long way — off
Love of anger without covering
Home of purified passages — literally, that is
Big castle in France seen during European journey
‘To — is worth ambition though in hell’ (Paradise Lost)
Coming up in the main?
The responsibility is subject to you and me
Stretch of water mixed up with lava — keen egg loses heart! —
Revolutionary cleaner employed on British ship
Take care with oil, perhaps, if you’re watching every one!
Part of the feet in flight, maybe
Instructions for the troops to leave?
Medicine goes partly into nice dish
Rejected actors?
Bob endures fast mules a-wandering
Not quite magic, but fairly good poker hand!
Femininely powerful, apparently South American?
Nearly equal in value to following scrap of weed
Reserved in manner when finished with work
What marks the spot in front of fish can be very penetrating
Soldier turns up — or is it an operatic prince?
